secrets.name: Room 216
secrets.text: A room with no door. The bed has been slept in, the lamp is on, and every wall is books to the ceiling. The television is showing the corridor outside, empty, from above.

meta.label: The Motel
meta.blurb: A motel corridor, carpeted, lit, very long. Every door has a number and every room behind them is the same room. There is no desk, no car park, no road.
